record.one_liner: Marketing automation and customer data platform for email, SMS, flows and campaigns, with a REST-style /api.
record.auth_notes: Private API keys (Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key) for /api endpoints; OAuth for apps acting on behalf of other accounts. Public site-ID key is for client-side /client endpoints only and is counted as api_key.
record.access_notes: critic: confirmed self_serve_free; vendor pricing page lists a free plan (up to 250 active profiles, 500 emails per month) and private keys are created in account Settings by any user who can open it, with no paid-plan gate.
record.api_notes: Official docs describe JSON:API-style endpoints with per-endpoint rate limits. Breadth judged from the remote MCP exposing 260+ tools across campaigns, flows, profiles, segments, reporting, catalogs and events.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict ready_with_review -> ready, main_blocker app_review -> none. Private keys and self-built OAuth apps work immediately on a free account; app review is only required to list in Klaviyo's App Marketplace (plus 5 active installs), not to use the API.
